notes.title: English Translation Update
notes.notes:
2021/02/28 
English translation of Three of Cards has been updated.
You can turn on English mode by clicking on the paper joker button in main title or ESC menu.
The translations are not imperfect yet, but I hope everyone would enjoy it.
Feedbacks and reports about errors in translation are always welcome.
